Headline: A Point Estate at the End of the Reach
Description: Set at the very end of the reach on nearly four private acres, this shingle-and-stone point estate takes in open water on three sides, with two hundred and forty feet of owned shorefront, a deep-water dock rated for a forty-foot boat, and a protected mooring in the cove. Inside, five bedrooms and four and a half baths open to water from nearly every room, a chef's kitchen with two islands gives onto a glassed morning room, and the primary suite holds its own wing with a stone fireplace and a private balcony over the water. A carriage house, a heated gunite pool, mature gardens laid out by a noted landscape architect, and a gated drive complete a property that comes to this stretch of the mid coast perhaps once in a generation.

Headline: Shingled Shorefront with a Deep-Water Dock
Description: Weathered-shingle Colonial on the water with a private dock, a stone terrace and open bay views from the main rooms. A short walk to the village.

Headline: Bay-Facing Contemporary on the Ledge
Description: Glass-and-cedar contemporary set on a granite ledge above the bay, with walls of glass, an open plan and long afternoon light throughout.

Headline: Restored Sea Captain's House
Description: An 1840s captain's house restored to the studs, with wide-board floors, four fireplaces and a wraparound porch, minutes from the beach.

Headline: Corner-Lot Starter, Steps to the Harbor
Description: Tidy three-bed on a sunny corner lot, a short walk to the working harbour. New furnace, level yard, room to grow. Open Sunday, one to three.

Headline: Village Cape with a New Roof
Description: Updated village Cape with a new roof, refinished floors and an eat-in kitchen. Fenced yard, off-street parking, walk to town.

Headline: Updated Ranch on a Quiet Street
Description: Single-level ranch with an open kitchen, a two-car garage and a private back yard on a quiet dead-end street.

Headline: Two-Family Near the Waterfront
Description: Well-kept two-family a few blocks from the waterfront: live in one and rent the other, separate utilities and off-street parking.

Headline: In-Town Cottage with a Deep Yard
Description: Storybook in-town cottage with a deep, private yard and a detached studio, a short walk to Camden's shops and harbour.

Headline: Classic Camden Colonial
Description: Center-entrance Colonial on High Street with generous rooms, a formal dining room and a screened porch over the garden.

Headline: Harborside Bungalow
Description: Cozy harborside bungalow with water peeks, a farmer's porch and a new kitchen, minutes to the ferry and the galleries.

Headline: Sea Meadow Cottage with Meadow Views
Description: Shingled cottage above a tidal meadow with long views, an open kitchen and a screened porch, a short walk to the harbour.
